name: DBK Custom Apparel & Printing
old_description: DTF printing can be used on various fabrics, including cotton, polyester, and blends.
about:
DBK Custom Apparel & Printing operates from Cabot, Arkansas. The business was founded by Kursten, who turned a personal passion for crafting into a custom apparel operation focused on making personalized clothing easy, affordable, and personal. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in direct-to-film (DTF) printing, a process that transfers full-color designs from a printed wax film onto garments using a heat press. The method works on cotton, polyester, and blended fabrics, producing prints that resist cracking and fading. DBK also runs a wholesale apparel program and advertises a standard turnaround of three business days, with same-day completion available for walk-in customers.

Customers include businesses needing branded merchandise, schools and teams ordering event shirts, and individuals marking special occasions. The wholesale side supplies blank and printed apparel to other resellers.

Kursten emphasizes a hands-on, friendly experience where clients are part of the process from idea to finished shirt, aiming to make custom apparel accessible without sacrificing quality.
